craft_notes: Sthāyin: breath-cycle (four-phase). Sanskrit: kumbhitā recitā vāpi pūritā vā yadā bhavet tadante śāntanāmāsau → L4 keeps the or-chain whole line 1. Rows: row 3 (any-phase end-calm). Close: forth (calm shines — present, not future). Rejected: 'retention' for kumbhaka — killed: kumbhaka kept (loanword practice-name); 'at its end' moved — kept.

lines: Kumbhaka-held or exhaled or inhaled, whenever so —
at its end this is calm: by power, calm shines forth.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kumbhitā recitā vāpi pūritā vā yadā bhavet | tadante śāntanāmāsau śaktyā śāntaḥ prakāśate

reads_against.argmap: Which breath-phase brings calm? → End of any breath-phase is the calm that shines by power.
c1_essence: Any breath-phase's end is the calm that shines by power.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness carrying resolve)
